transcript: . >> One of the ways that I like to look at how to go about managing a crisis is I like to think about how my future self will tell the story of the crisis that's going on. What is the story I'm going to tell when I look back at having survived this crisis? And what this does, this exercise helps me make better choices in the present. When I look back at this, am I going to say, hey, there was a quarantine for six months, and I watched every episode on Netflix and I increased my drinking 85%. Is that the story I'm going to be telling people? Or am I going to say, during that crisis, I interviewed more people than I had ever done in my life. I came up with six new offerings and I reached out to people every day and grew my business during that time. Or at the minimum, I was able to maintain the growth of my business. I didn't go out of business. So what is the story you want to tell when you look back at having survived this crisis? What story is going to be the one that's going to help take your business to the next level?
